mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have mainly clear skies at Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 68 degrees. Tonight the moon is in its third quarter phase, and you can look forward to an overnight low of 60 degrees with no rain predicted.
The City of Verona continues to maintain transparency by providing regular engineering service reports from AECOM, with the latest filings available through the city website.

Today in Verona, you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, visit the downtown Farmer's Market, or join in for Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, look forward to Concerts in the Park at Century School and more trivia at Hop Haus Brewing.
Regarding local public safety, on the morning of last Thursday, a driver was stopped for equipment violations and subsequently arrested for an O W I.
Today's delicious flavor is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Culver's is open until 10 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
